metric.definition: Order-to-delivery time for transformers, switchgear, generators, cooling plant, and high-end accelerators.

reading.body:
Critical equipment lead times now gate data center construction as hard as permits do, because transformer and switchgear order-to-delivery times have stretched from months to years.

The metric tracks order-to-delivery time for transformers, switchgear, generators, cooling plant, and high-end accelerators. These are the power and thermal components a data center cannot open without, so longer waits directly delay the buildings that house compute. Even if capital and land are ready, construction schedules wait on equipment.

The data does not include actual lead-time values, regional variation, or a time series beyond the statement that times stretched from months to years. It also covers only the five equipment categories listed. Surveys from industry groups and research firms are the source, but no specific survey results appear here.
